notes.title: BIG UPDATE #1.1: Bunny Adventure!
notes.notes:
Hey, VR Flippers! 🥽

Changes are good, so it's update time! 
We are excited to announce our first major update! We have implemented several features based on the requests and suggestions of our dedicated player community, including a new pet - the lovable bunny! We have also introduced customizable settings, additional character customization options, and improved user interface elements.

Without wasting any more time, let's dive straight into the [b]NEWS[/b]!

[h3][b]New Content:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New pet - a bunny, which appears by default in the player's house at the beginning.
[*] Added a tab for bunnies to the selector.
[*] Extended hunger duration. The initial value is set randomly (maximum at 75%).
[*] Added a bunny to random missions.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/a516ec861f9c63a1269f18c2753b93f1f40327ba.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Menu and Tutorial Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievement for completing the tutorial.
[*] The information about player joining, now displays correctly when using the pause menu.
[*] Removed the hosting game button in friends-only mode.
[*] Fixed displaying the current server region in the main menu.[/list]

[h3][b]Pets and Furniture Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The dog won’t get stuck during playtime.
[*] Fixed the animal selector
[*] Your pet will no longer jump or destroy furniture from a long distance
[*] Fixed tile scale - now all tiles will fit properly![/list]

[h3][b]Other Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed rotation of the second player's furniture moving a gun
[*] Fixed random missions - the campaign mission was mistakenly marked as completed after completing a random mission, that won’t happen again! 
[*] Removed excessive home-style missions from House 5.[/list]

And with that, we conclude today's patch notes, Flippers! Now, the gameplay is smoother and more enjoyable. So, like a bunny, jump into House Flipper Pets and let's see what adventures await you!
But wait! There's more news. To celebrate our Bunny Adventure update, House Flipper Pets is now 60% off! Catch it with a huge discount.[h3] [b]Hurry, the deal is from June 15th to 22nd![/b][/h3]
Remember to check our social media for the latest news, and steam page for upcoming updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839190/House_Flipper_Pets_VR/

[b]Happy Gaming! [/b]
~Frozen Way Team

notes.title: HF Pets VR – Update #2 and patch notes! It’s virtual, but the fixes are real! 🐞
notes.notes:
Hey there, VR Flippers! 🥽

It’s been a few weeks since the release, and we already bring you a small update with fixes and changes! 

Our team has improved upon some general issues and multiplayer bugs. Now you’ll be able to buy everything you need for one of the missions, no loans necessary.

We also made a small change to multiplayer – finish a job with a friend and high five to see what happens!

So, without further ado, let's get to the [b]news[/b]!

[h3][b]General fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the funds necessary to purchase the required items in “Dog house” quest
[*] Fixed the issue where some players were spawning outside the house
[/list]
[h3][b]Multiplayer fixes and changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Room “join code” is now correctly displayed 
[*] Fixed cases when joining player didn't see wall or floor materials properly
[*] Increase AFK kick time to 15 min
[*] Players can now High Five each other!
[/list]
[h3][b]Improved pet AI:[/b][/h3] 
[list]
[*] Pets can now sleep on carpets 
[*] Pets will now get angry when left alone in the room 
[/list]
[h3][b]Furniture/Materials fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple wallpapers and floor materials inside one furniball
[*] Fixed selling items with red furniballs
[*] Fixed a bug where incompatible furniture would glow red even though the other player was trying to change material
[*] Fixed some carpet models 
[*] Fixed an issue with NOT showing the names above images on shop keyboards
[/list]
[h3][b]Grab fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed distance grabbing small items – items will now better snap to the players' hands 
[*] Fixed grabbing items spawned by another player[/list]
[b][h3]Sound fixes and changes:[/h3][/b][list]
[*] Fixed some sounds (loading music, cockroaches) and added new ones
[/list]
Alright, Flippers, that would be it for today’s patch notes. I hope you’ll be bug-free from now on, and start a new game with pleasure! Let’s get back on track and see how our VR pets are doing!
Remember to check our social media for latest news, and steam page for upcoming updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839190/House_Flipper_Pets_VR/

Meanwhile, have a lovely time VR flipping!

~Frozen Way Team

notes.title: House Flipper Pets VR is LIVE! Your virtual ticket to multiplayer is here!
notes.notes:
Listen up, Guys!

House Flipper Pets VR is [b]LIVE![/b] We’ve been working hard to bring you everything on time, and here it is! Now you can give your apartments a new life, train pets and play with them and a friend in multiplayer!

Most importantly, we’d like to thank you for all your support. This journey has been a wild ride at times, but we’ve been able to get to where we are with your help. Now we look into the future and focus on improving every part of our game, so you may think of it as a new beginning. We start Early Access today. Feel free to give us everything you’ve got! Every comment will be an asset. Take a look at the steam page, and start virtual flipping 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839190/House_Flipper_Pets_VR/

If that wasn’t enough, let’s heat the atmosphere with our new release trailer! 🔥

[previewyoutube=8lXl4BhEJKM;full][release trailer][/previewyoutube]

Now, are you ready for more? Alright then, it’s time for the news!

[h3][b]Multiplayer & Mechanics[/b][/h3]

There’s no time to talk, so let’s jump into the main feature of this game – Cooperation mode! Join your friend, flip new houses, enjoy the company of different cat and dog breeds, and many more, hand in hand with your buddy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/72c17d596a5876304bfbda948e59c371cd92ecf6.gif[/img]

Roll them out from top to bottom and give your room a fresh look. With the floor and walls customization mechanics, you'll be able to create your dream house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/bf71bc5fc9845a6e0581851314a92a5bf1fa2152.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/20470f90f689af3ce37b793ce30a7773d0a982bd.gif[/img]

Are you bored with the old furniture? Just open the store and pick a Furniball you like, it’s easier than you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/19886bec4a9bb4888f48ec27309fc5480d43786e.gif[/img]

Toss the furniball on your item. It’ll change into your desired one. Turn the process of apartment renovation and furnishing into a joyful play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/a3017156ba5cc47f5c967e2baab678830d91c978.gif[/img]

To keep you and your pets in good condition, we’ve shown you tug of war last time, now’s the time for another game! Playing fetch is one of the most popular (and fun!) ways to entertain your dog. Make your four-legged companions happy with that round toy you toss. Your cat also loves to play, so give him a ball and see how it reacts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/36b1986ddc2182220e74a230f0b23183b8ac4859.gif[/img]


So, that would be it for today, flippers. We had a great time making the game and updates for you. Now we leave the rest in your hands. Play, cooperate, flip, and pet your companions in virtual reality. Last but not least: House Flipper Pets VR is coming with a 10% launch discount – so don’t hesitate and grab yourself a copy. Please don’t forget that it’s early access, and we still need your feedback. If you want to keep up to date, check out and follow us on social media for fresh news. Let us know what you think and have fun!

PS: You thought it was the end, but it was me, BUNDLE! With the House Flipper Sale, we've got plenty goods for you, guys. Check those suprises we've prepared and dive into flipping world!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29605/Joy_of_life/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29601/Welcome_Home/

Meanwhile, have a lovely time VR flipping!

~Frozen Way Team

notes.title: HF Pets VR Release is SET! — Your virtual animals await on 15th of December!
notes.notes:
[h3]Listen up, VR flippers! 🎮🥽[/h3]

THE RELEASE DATE OF THE [b]HOUSE FLIPPER PETS VR[/b] IS SET! Get ready to pet your virtual animals on the [b]15TH OF DECEMBER![/b] These animal-friendly houses need your discerning eye, so prepare for some flipping, and much more!

I hope you’ve got some popcorn at the ready, because we’ve prepared [b]A NEW TRAILER[/b] for you. Please let us know what you think in the comment section.

[previewyoutube=bhsUTga9Yw8;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been a long journey, but now we’ve come to the climax. Excitement almost took my breath away. However, at first, we’d love to thank you guys for your support and patience. We’ve tried our best to deliver the best experience possible on time. 

Anyway, let's jump to the fresh news!

[h3][b]MECHANICS[/b][/h3]

It’s not all about flipping this time, but we didn’t forget about it. Even inside virtual reality, your floors can shine like new with our cleaning tool, so check it out and start sweeping.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/ac151ead1b6cff81c0a27cc1929e5795e838f379.gif[/img][/list]

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/78b590eb8bdf2587bd3ecd0ad16706459b3b72e2.gif[/img][/list]

Now, after we got rid of the trash and dirt – it’s time for some fun. There are plenty of pet-related interactions available in-game, but today, I’d love to present you tug-of-war. Grab your toy, and invite your dog to the contest! Let’s see who’ll win!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/c64d6e3cdd16d86a91c43403e5993e0744c9f652.gif[/img][/list]

Having pets isn’t just fun, there are some responsibilities too. There’s also time to feed our fur friends. But before that, let’s pour some water into the bowl. They look thirsty.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/c4b5cd24cfb3172fadd08e55aef60c41bbf678eb.gif[/img][/list]

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/12afbd7271bb8d470d5f4d0fb9648cfff03caefe.gif[/img][/list]

There’s no better time to feed your pet than after a satisfying play session. Take care of your little ones, feed them well and spend time together.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/712600902990173ad16efa25051a2eb6abee9838.gif[/img][/list]

You can also give your cat a snack! So delicious.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/3f32cc57fe06f6f2a6e829b19e92b62ffebe29d2.gif[/img][/list]

You can also cover your pets under the box. Something like the opposite of Schrödinger’s cat. That’s how you turn the table!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/db1a79796b0f8fd9bd46caeddfe6aa95d39ff767.gif[/img][/list]

Growing closer with your animal is nice, but petting them with joy and love is a hundred times better! There is no such thing as enough of a cheerful dog or cat! Just look at this festival of cuteness!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/da57bbacbc631a7bbb2752a28cdb789ef6423783.gif[/img][/list]

[h3][b]Keep up with the latest[/b][/h3]

Okay, guys, that would be it for today. I hope you’re as excited as we are! Let us know how you liked this update and our new trailer, and remember the date: 15th of December, the release of HF Pets VR! It’ll be a great pleasure to finally let you enjoy all our game has to offer. Please check and follow our social media and Steam page for upcoming news:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839190/House_Flipper_Pets_VR/

Meanwhile, have a lovely time VR flipping!


~Frozen Way Team

notes.title: Pets VR Development update #1 - Your virtual animals are here! 🐕‍🦺😺
notes.notes:
Hello there, VR flippers! 🎮🥽

Who let the dogs out? Oh yeah, that's us! A few months ago, we announced a brand-new VR game, and this was just the beginning of this adventure! Full of passion, we constantly work on developing it. We’ve gathered tons of feedback from you, which helped us in overcoming some obstacles. We’d like to thank you for constant support, and if you still have any ideas or suggestions related to the game, throw them at us in the comments section below.

Since the last announcement, we’ve managed to prepare for you some fresh stuff. We hope that they will shed new light on what is yet to come! Please keep in mind it’s still work in progress, and may not represent the final version of the game.

Before the fresh news, check out the Pets VR trailer again if you have missed it. 🎥🎬

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=43VRBRZMFnc

Without further ado…

Let's start with what's new. We've created some environments where your four-legged friends can feel comfortable. Arrange your own cozziness according to your needs, and jump to vr flipping. 🛋️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/734765ae3fe3fecffc53de9ba863bd15b199048a.jpg[/img]
[i]Doesn't that look amazing? Let us know in the comments below what you guys think?[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/f19c5503cdeefe1aa9c08d8eb3bc9573ce2a7bcd.jpg[/img]

Fancy for some interesting items that will add some coolness to your suroudings? Then wait no longer! Check some of the items below and let us know in the comments below what you think of them. However, your animal companions won't be able to interact with them, but there is no need to be worried! There will be other, different interactions with your four-legged friends, so stay tuned for some more information. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/5cf7b4314756bbc3152f3f5ef8c53f32d07df21a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/12ec6b83f9763ff718b7361ddd7678b843cd7cb1.jpg[/img]

It's almost beyond our imagination... House Flipper Pets VR with cooperation mode? Yes, that's true, you can join with friend, and flip your house as you wish toghether! Within all of our previous mechanics, this is unique, one and only feature of this game. Please, keep in mind that it's still work in progress, so if you have any questions related to such a mechanic, drop your comments below!

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/8e942280c2d65df4914d50bfbd9851b599e7728c.gif[/img]
[/list]
Who doesn’t love sitting in the garden and relaxing? We hope you’ll enjoy it as much as we do. All of this thanks to the new furniture which was prepared especially for you! Check them out, let us know what you think about such style. 🪑

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/6343820b786a5397b9cb6f1fa207fce2ce4698bc.jpg[/img]

The Garden isn’t the only place where you can rest. Make your bedroom special with the new objects we’ve managed to prepare. Comfy bedsheets and fancy furniture will make your imagination run wild.🛏️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/de75234f3c4caf5430884c03255789ae84070b88.jpg[/img]

Apart from previous screenshots, we’re also really excited to show you some new designs that we’ve created. Take a look at some more objects we’re working on. Feel free to let us know what you think about them in the comments section below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/b7ec8209bcb98224ec421caa3eb89defd10c30c9.png[/img]

Aaaaand now! Have fun playing with your cat! We’ve come up with a cool feature, which allows you and your meow friend to spend some time together. Let him follow your movements with a laser pointer. 🐈‍

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642253/46afbfc58f7b5992c72af416a4a3d776fcf0d8b6.gif[/img]
[/list]
[i]PS: Don’t worry, The laser passes through animals, so you can’t light into their eyes and thus damage their sight[/i]

We’ve come to the end of this dev update, vr-flippurrrs. We hope you liked the new stuff that we’ve showcased to you. Once again, thank you for all of your support and every opinion. Last, but not least, don’t hesitate to give us some additional feedback as it would be an asset, so please share it with us below! We’ll try to answer as soon as possible.

Remember to follow our social media channels to stay up to date with the latest news. If you still haven’t done it yet, you can add House Flipper – Pets VR to your wishlist. 🙇‍♂️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839190/House_Flipper_Pets_VR/

Meanwhile, have some lovely time VR-flipping!

~Frozen Way team
